stories.title: Rebel named first honorary board member of I AM ALS
stories.tldr: Former AEW star Tanea Rebel Brooks has been named the first-ever honorary member of the I AM ALS Board of Directors following her impactful advocacy work. Her new leadership role coincides with the final congressional passage of the ACT for ALS reauthorization bill, which extends critical funding and treatment access. Since sharing her ALS diagnosis earlier this year, Brooks has worked tirelessly with the patient-led organization, inspiring fans through fundraising efforts, special merchandise, and a dedicated AEW Dynamite event.

stories.title: Eddie Kingston replaces Tommy End & Xelina at PROGRESS Chapter 199
stories.tldr: Tommy End, also known as Malakai Black, and Xelina have pulled out of the upcoming PROGRESS Wrestling Chapter 199: BoneStorm event due to an unexpected personal matter. PROGRESS co-owner Big Damo announced the cancellation while emphasizing a family-first approach and noting they hope to bring the duo back in 2027. In response, AEW star Eddie Kingston has stepped up to replace End and will face the youngest PROGRESS Triple Crown winner in history, Luke Jacobs, on October 25. Additionally, OTT Wrestling in Ireland renamed their October 24 event to NewEnd following the changes.

stories.title: Adam Copeland replaces injured AEW star in Clockwork Carnage match
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland is set to compete in the first-ever Clockwork Carnage match for the AEW World Championship at WrestleDream 2026. However, reports indicate he only entered the bout after Jay White suffered an injury during the All Out pre-show. Copeland was originally planned to team with Christian Cage, but Cage's own severe injuries at All Out forced creative changes that ultimately shifted Copeland into White's vacant spot.

stories.title: Tony Khan discusses Skydance corporate leadership reaction to AEW
stories.tldr: During the WrestleDream media call, AEW President Tony Khan expressed strong optimism about the promotion's future following Skydance’s acquisition and merger involving Warner Bros Discovery and Paramount. Khan revealed that he has had encouraging discussions with Skydance CEO David Ellison, who is reportedly very excited about AEW and the brand being built. Additionally, Khan emphasized the importance of retaining key corporate allies like Channing Dungey and JB Perrette, whose continued leadership will help drive AEW's ongoing growth and content strategy across platforms like HBO Max.

stories.title: Tony Khan AEW WrestleDream media call summary
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan addressed the media ahead of the WrestleDream pay-per-view, discussing major corporate changes following Skydance's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. He provided updates on Adam Copeland's upcoming 2027 retirement and revealed that Christian Cage suffered a punctured lung and three broken ribs just five minutes into his match at All Out. Khan also touched on potential talent returns and statuses for Mick Foley, The Hurt Syndicate, and Taya Valkyrie. Additionally, he shared positive outlooks on AEW's television distribution and future growth under the new ownership structure.

stories.title: Austin Creed reveals Swerve Strickland's original pitch for New Level in AEW
stories.tldr: After departing WWE in early 2026, Austin Creed and Kofi debuted in AEW as the New Level at All In 2026 by aligning with Swerve Strickland. In a recent interview, Creed explained that Strickland pitched the trios partnership as an immediate way to face numerous top tag teams starting right at Wembley Stadium. The strategy proved successful when the group captured the AEW World Trios Championship just minutes after their debut.

stories.title: Bryan & Vinny review AEW Dynamite, Collision, Overrun, and NXT
stories.tldr: The latest episode of the podcast covers a particularly rough week of professional wrestling programming. The hosts break down a combined three hours and twenty-eight minutes of AEW Dynamite, Collision, and an overrun that ultimately failed to impress. Additionally, they share their harsh thoughts on what they considered to be a very poor edition of NXT. Despite the grim review of the shows themselves, the podcast remains an entertaining listen for fans.

stories.title: Tony Khan comments on Hurt Syndicate creative plans in AEW
stories.tldr: During a media call ahead of the WrestleDream pay-per-view, AEW President Tony Khan was asked about future creative plans for the Hurt Syndicate and Mick Foley. Khan delivered a rambling response that danced around the question without offering any concrete updates on their status or upcoming usage. Instead of detailing future plans, he simply recapped their past summer storylines and praised recent company events. Fans are left wondering if the veteran group will continue to make random appearances without a clear long-term direction.

stories.title: Mike Bailey reflects on AEW Montreal homecoming
stories.tldr: AEW star Mike Bailey recently spoke about his emotional homecoming in Montreal during AEW Redemption, where he won the International Title number one contender ladder match. He shared that standing atop the ladder and seeing his mother live at a wrestling event for the first time in his 20-year career was deeply moving. Surrounded by family, close friends, and members of the tight-knit Quebec wrestling community, Bailey secured a contract for a title shot at Grand Slam. Looking ahead, Bailey is currently scheduled to compete in the Clockwork Carnage match for the World Championship at AEW WrestleDream 2026.

stories.title: Adam Copeland retirement plans and potential final match location
stories.tldr: Following Adam Copeland's retirement announcement, backstage reports indicate that AEW has not yet locked in a date, opponent, or location for his final match in 2027. While Toronto is heavily speculated as a potential homecoming venue, Tony Khan also addressed the possibility of Copeland wrestling at the Tokyo Dome before hanging up his boots. Khan confirmed he is aware of Copeland's career bucket-list goals but chose to keep any potential plans involving NJPW under wraps.

stories.title: Jamie Hayter injured, forced off AEW WrestleDream 2026 card
stories.tldr: Following Jamie Hayter's injury from All Out, her scheduled WrestleDream tag team title defense alongside Alex Windsor has been officially postponed. A new pre-show match featuring Sisters of Sin and Divine Dominion has been added to the pay-per-view card in its place. Meanwhile, Tony Khan expects Hayter to be cleared to return within the next couple of weeks.

stories.title: Christian Cage wrestled through serious injuries at AEW All Out
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan revealed that Christian Cage aggressively tried to shake off medical staff and downplayed his severe All Out injuries to finish the match. Khan admitted that the terrifying health scare coincided with a historically dark 24-hour period for the company that also involved mourning the sudden deaths of PAC and Ben. Cage's ongoing recovery has now forced management to alter creative plans for the veteran star.

stories.title: Samoa Joe discusses wrestler grief support following deaths of PAC and The Butcher
stories.tldr: AEW star Samoa Joe recently addressed how the wrestling community has supported one another following the tragic deaths of PAC and Andy Williams. Expanding on the locker room's grief, Joe explained that coping involves simple acts like being available for late-night phone calls rather than following any formal protocol. He noted that these profound losses are felt industry-wide and praised management for their sensitivity during this difficult time. Joe also shared that these events have given performers a deeper appreciation for their opportunities in the ring.

stories.title: Mick Foley says he fits Tony Khan's AEW management style
stories.tldr: Mick Foley is further clarifying his wrestling allegiance by praising Tony Khan's management style and appreciation for talent. The hardcore legend explained that his exit from WWE stemmed from discomfort with the company's ties to Donald Trump and that he has zero regrets about leaving. Furthermore, Foley credited AEW with keeping WWE wrestler salaries high through healthy market competition, noting the importance of having an alternative promotion.

stories.title: AEW WrestleDream card features 8 title matches and pre-show bout
stories.tldr: Tony Khan finalized a massive eleven-match card for this Saturday's WrestleDream pay-per-view in Orlando, Florida, featuring eight championship bouts and two pre-show clashes. The newly unveiled matchups include title defenses for Andrade El Idolo and Persephone, a high-stakes stipulation match between Chris Jericho and Nick Wayne, and the start of a legendary tag team series. Fans will also witness a chaotic eight-way Clockwork Carnage match for the world title alongside several other high-profile championship defenses.

stories.title: Clockwork Carnage match qualifiers and updates for AEW WrestleDream
stories.tldr: The field for the first-ever Clockwork Carnage match at AEW WrestleDream has been finalized following a massive night of qualifiers across Dynamite and Collision. Adam Copeland, Konosuke Takeshita, Kazuchika Okada, Ricochet, and Darby Allin all punched their tickets to the high-stakes multi-man bout for the AEW World Championship. Notably, Adam Copeland also shocked fans by announcing during a post-match promo that 2027 will be his final year in professional wrestling. These stars join Will Ospreay, Samoa Joe, and Mike Bailey to round out the loaded card.

stories.title: Adam Copeland retirement announcement and Christian Cage injury update
stories.tldr: During the October 14, 2026 episode of AEW Dynamite, Adam Copeland defeated Josh Alexander to qualify for the Clockwork Carnage match at WrestleDream. Following the victory, Copeland shockingly announced that 2027 will be his final year in professional wrestling. He also provided a staggering update on his tag team partner Christian Cage, revealing that Cage suffered three broken ribs and a collapsed lung just five minutes into their ladder match at All Out. With his career winding down, Copeland stated his ultimate goal is to capture the AEW World Championship before officially hanging up his boots.

stories.title: FTR and Motor City Machine Guns best-of-five series at AEW WrestleDream
stories.tldr: During a recent episode of AEW Dynamite, FTR called out the Young Bucks for a tag team title opportunity based on their prior three-out-of-five record against them. Instead, the Motor City Machine Guns interrupted and challenged FTR to their own best-of-five series to prove who is the best team in the division. Although MCMG wanted the action to start immediately, FTR manager Stokely Hathaway insisted the matchup deserved a grander stage. The opening match of the series has now been officially scheduled for the upcoming AEW WrestleDream pay-per-view.

stories.title: Samoa Joe comments on losses of PAC and Andy Williams and AEW talent potential
stories.tldr: AEW star Samoa Joe recently reflected on how the locker room has coped with the tragic and close losses of PAC and Andy Williams. During the same interview, Joe identified Queen Aminata, Trish Adora, and Action Andretti as rising stars with massive untapped potential. He also discussed the company shifting into an exciting new era led by younger talent breaking into the main event scene. Additionally, he briefly touched upon the viral response to a recent conversation regarding his religious faith.

stories.title: Christian Cage injury updates from AEW All Out
stories.tldr: Christian Cage suffered severe injuries, including three broken ribs and a collapsed lung, during a three-way ladder match at AEW All Out. Despite sustaining the injuries just five minutes into the bout when he was thrown into a ladder, Cage remarkably continued to wrestle until the closing moments. The news was publicly revealed by his longtime tag partner Adam Copeland during a promo on Dynamite, where Copeland also announced that he plans to retire from in-ring competition in 2027. No official timetable has been released for Cage's return to the ring.

stories.title: Teases and rumors regarding Ilja Dragunov arriving in AEW
stories.tldr: AEW has aired a mysterious vignette featuring an orchestra conductor and a metronome, strongly hinting at the imminent debut of former WWE star Ilja Dragunov. Dragunov reportedly signed with AEW in September after choosing not to renew his contract, making him a free agent following his departure in August. With visa issues apparently resolved and the upcoming WrestleDream pay-per-view this Saturday, fans eagerly anticipate his official arrival.

stories.title: Jon Moxley comments on pain and recent AEW TV pinfall loss
stories.tldr: Jon Moxley suffered a rare pinfall loss to Mark Davis on AEW Dynamite, marking his first time being pinned on television since April. Following the defeat, a visibly distraught Moxley broke down backstage and admitted to Renee Paquette that he can no longer distinguish between physical and emotional pain. The shocking events and mounting pressure have significantly shifted the momentum heading into Moxley's upcoming AEW Continental Championship defense against Davis at WrestleDream.

stories.title: TBS Championship and National title matches added to AEW WrestleDream
stories.tldr: AEW has added several major matches to this Saturday's WrestleDream pay-per-view following the latest television broadcasts. National Champion Andrade El Idolo will defend his title against Tommaso Ciampa, and TBS Champion Persephone will put her belt on the line in a four-way match. The stacked event will also feature a trilogy bout between Chris Jericho and Nick Wayne alongside a massive lineup of championship defenses.

stories.title: Chris Jericho vs. Nick Wayne rubber match set for AEW WrestleDream
stories.tldr: Chris Jericho and Nick Wayne are set to collide in a highly anticipated rubber match at AEW WrestleDream to settle their tied 1-1 series. The match was made official after a war of words on television where Wayne demanded an apology stipulation if he wins, followed by Jericho blindsiding him with a low blow. With personal animosity and pride on the line, the two rivals will finally settle their score this Saturday on the pay-per-view card.

stories.title: Kenny Omega eyeing NJPW Wrestle Kingdom return
stories.tldr: Former AEW World Champion Kenny Omega recently made a surprise return to New Japan Pro Wrestling by attacking reigning IWGP Heavyweight Champion Yota Tsuji. Omega will now compete in a triple threat match against Tsuji and Boltin Oleg at Power Struggle 2026 to earn his official title shot. In a recent interview, Omega revealed his ambition to win the championship at Wrestle Kingdom 21 inside the Tokyo Dome. He criticized Tsuji for lacking experience and stated his desire to show the entire New Japan roster what a truly dominant champion looks like.

stories.title: Jamie Hayter injury update by Tony Khan
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan announced that Jamie Hayter is sidelined with an injury stemming from the Chicago Street Fight at All Out. Hayter, one-half of the AEW Women's World Tag Team Champions known as The Brawling Birds alongside Alex Windsor, missed a scheduled defense of their titles. Khan expressed optimism that she will be able to return to action within a couple of weeks.

stories.title: Sisters Of Sin vs. Divine Dominion added to AEW WrestleDream Tailgate Brawl
stories.tldr: A new women's tag team match has been officially added to the upcoming AEW WrestleDream Tailgate Brawl event. The showdown will feature the Sisters Of Sin pairing of Julia Hart and Skye Blue squaring off against the Divine Dominion duo of Megan Bayne and Lena Kross. This exciting booking stems from recent television action on Dynamite, where the Triangle Of Madness secured a victory over Mercedes Mone and Divine Dominion. Fans attending or tuning into the Saturday event will also get to witness the opening bout of a high-stakes Best of Five series between FTR and the Motor City Machine Guns.

stories.title: Mystery vignette airs on AEW Collision
stories.tldr: A cryptic 25-second video package aired during the latest episode of AEW Collision, strongly hinting at the upcoming debut of a new talent. The footage featured imagery of a metronome, an individual conducting music, a person descending a staircase, and someone running in a training ring. Promotion officials have not yet revealed the identity of the wrestler behind the teasers, leaving fans and pundits speculating about who might be arriving in the promotion.

stories.title: Comedian Mojo Brookzz appears on AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: Comedian Mojo Brookzz made a surprising appearance on AEW Dynamite during a special broadcast from Cleveland, Ohio, aligning himself with The New Level and Prince Nana. Filling in for the absent Swerve Strickland due to family matters, Brookzz joined the AEW World Trios Champions to hype their upcoming 2-out-of-3 falls title match at WrestleDream. Brookzz brings millions of social media followers to the promotion and is currently scheduled to be on tour until early December 2026.

stories.title: Andrade El Idolo vs. Tommaso Ciampa match added to AEW WrestleDream
stories.tldr: AEW has officially added a high-profile singles match between Andrade El Idolo and Tommaso Ciampa to the upcoming WrestleDream pay-per-view. The announcement was made during the October 14, 2026 episode of television, hot on the heels of a chaotic tag team main event. In that preview match, Ciampa and Samoa Joe defeated Andrade and AEW World Champion Will Ospreay after Joe locked in the Coquina Clutch on Andrade. Now, Andrade will look for personal redemption and a definitive victory when he faces Ciampa one-on-one this Saturday.

stories.title: Wardlow gets first AEW win in over two years
stories.tldr: Wardlow recently returned to AEW television as part of the Don Callis Family following a hiatus that began in March 2024. After dropping his initial return match, he secured his first victory in over two years when his stable defeated the Death Riders in a trios match on Dynamite. Mark Davis pinned AEW Continental Champion Jon Moxley to set up their upcoming title match at the WrestleDream pay-per-view. This milestone win, accompanied by an intense hype video, marks the aggressive return of Mr. Mayhem to the active roster.

stories.title: Kofi comments on AEW experience and Tony Khan
stories.tldr: Kofi recently discussed his positive experience joining AEW and praised Tony Khan for creating an infectious, energetic backstage environment. Alongside Austin Creed and Swerve Strickland, Kofi debuted as The New Level at All In to capture the AEW World Trios Championships on their very first night. He revealed that despite being the worst kept secret on the internet, their contracts were not finalized until less than 24 hours before the event. The newly crowned champions are now preparing to defend their titles against Hangman Page and Brodido at AEW WrestleDream 2026.

stories.title: STARDOM names confirmed for MyAEW PPV event
stories.tldr: Pro Wrestling EVE is bringing STARDOM stars Maika and Hanako to the United Kingdom for events in November, with their Sunday card broadcasting live as a pay-per-view on MyAEW. The stacked lineup features multiple crossover talents from AEW, including Skye Blue challenging for the Spirit of EVE Championship. Additionally, champions Kris Statlander and Miyu Yamashita will put their respective titles on the line against Kay Lee Ray and Marina Shafir.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite ticket sales update
stories.tldr: Tonight features a three-hour television block of AEW Dynamite and Collision live from the Wolstein Center in Cleveland, Ohio. Ticket tracking indicates that approximately 2,771 seats have been distributed so far, marking an increase of 145 tickets over the last day. Fans can still secure standard admission seats starting at $34.35, with around 82 tickets currently floating on the resale market.

stories.title: David Finlay Details Aspects Of AEW He's Still Adjusting To
stories.tldr: Former New Japan Pro Wrestling star David Finlay has opened up about the adjustments he has had to make since joining All Elite Wrestling earlier this year. Speaking on Chris Jericho's podcast, Finlay discussed transitioning to AEW's distinct wrestling style, adjusting to television camera placements, and learning to work under strict time limits compared to his previous career. Despite these learning curves, he praised the much more manageable travel schedule and embraced the challenge of performing within tighter broadcast constraints.

stories.title: Jim Cornette comments on Max Caster's TNA debut and Riyadh joke
stories.tldr: Max Caster was fired by TNA following a controversial Bound for Glory debut where an unapproved freestyle rap referenced a glory hole and Riyadh. While the promotion quickly cut ties and scrubbed the footage, wrestling veteran Jim Cornette is now defending the wrestler. Cornette argues that Caster should not have lost his job over the incident, placing the blame instead on TNA's backstage producers for failing to vet the material beforehand.

stories.title: AEW WrestleDream match card and announcements
stories.tldr: Tony Khan heavily expanded the AEW WrestleDream lineup from six to eleven matches during the latest television tapings. The final card now features eight championship bouts, including newly added matches for the National and TBS titles, alongside a personal rubber match between Chris Jericho and Nick Wayne. Additionally, two pre-show matches were locked in, highlighted by the start of a Best 3 out of 5 series between FTR and the Motor City Machine Guns.

stories.title: Mick Foley compares AEW and WWE storytelling
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Mick Foley recently discussed his return to following professional wrestling during an appearance on The Mick and Kenny Show alongside Kofi Kingston. Foley explained that AEW currently speaks to him more than WWE because of how it handles its roster depth. He specifically praised AEW for making the middle of the card and the tag team division feel meaningful and important compared to other promotions.

stories.title: Samoa Joe praises Tony Khan's response to AEW tragedies
stories.tldr: Former AEW World Champion Samoa Joe has commended company president Tony Khan for his sensitive and admirable response to a difficult period marked by recent tragedies and the loss of several wrestling figures. Over the past month, AEW has held multiple tribute episodes following the passing of individuals including Rebel, Butcher, and PAC. Joe noted that while there is no official protocol for grief, the locker room has banded together with a sense of gratitude and a renewed appreciation for life.

stories.title: Kevin Knight discusses Steven Borden's injury at AEW All Out
stories.tldr: Wrestler Kevin Knight recently opened up about the frightening injury suffered by Steven Borden during a tag team match at AEW All Out 2026. After a rehearsed springboard clothesline went wrong and caused Borden to strike the back of his head on the mat, officials stopped the match. Knight accompanied Borden to the hospital and stayed with him overnight, noting that despite the scary bump, Borden was ultimately okay and they used the time to discuss growth and recovery.

stories.title: AEW talent booked in CMLL tag match with Tessa Blanchard
stories.tldr: Following recent teases, Dr. Britt Baker's official CMLL debut match has been set for this Friday at Arena Mexico. She will team with Persephone to take on Thunder Rosa and Tessa Blanchard in a marquee tag team match. The bout highlights a special all-female Viernes Espectacular card featuring various international talents and a major championship final.

stories.title: AEW stars react to WWE Men's Money in the Bank match
stories.tldr: Despite competing for rival promotions, several AEW stars publicly reacted to standout moments from the WWE Men's Money in the Bank ladder match. Je'Von Evans caught the attention of AEW's Ricochet after taking a massive, viral bump through an ambulance roof. Meanwhile, current AEW champion Andrade El Idolo took to social media to celebrate his former colleague Penta for winning the prestigious contract. These reactions highlight how professional fellowship often transcends company boundaries in the professional wrestling industry.

stories.title: Anthony Bowens provides knee injury and future update
stories.tldr: Former AEW World Tag Team Champion Anthony Bowens recently revealed in an interview that he is currently dealing with a slightly torn meniscus in his right knee, adding to a long list of injuries throughout his career including previous knee surgeries and concussions. Bowens also addressed his current free agency status following the expiration of his AEW contract, noting that he is taking things one day at a time. While he remained tight-lipped on his exact next steps to avoid widespread speculation, he admitted that he knows deep down what he wants to do next.

stories.title: AEW's Anna Jay to undergo surgery
stories.tldr: AEW star Anna Jay is set to undergo shoulder surgery to fix recurring dislocations that have kept her off television since June. She revealed on a Twitch stream that she sought multiple medical opinions before deciding on the procedure to ensure it was the right choice for her long-term health. This marks her second shoulder surgery in the company, following a previous operation in March 2021. Meanwhile, her future with the promotion is secured after Tony Khan confirmed she recently signed a contract extension.

stories.title: Jim Ross back in hospital due to low oxygen
stories.tldr: Legendary wrestling commentator Jim Ross has been hospitalized again due to low oxygen levels following a recent brain procedure for a shunt issue. The 74-year-old broadcaster shared the news on social media, noting his current weight of 198 pounds and expressing that he desperately needs a break from his ongoing health struggles. Ross has been away from the AEW commentary desk since May 2026, when he called the Continental Championship match at Double or Nothing.

stories.title: Skye Blue confirmed for MyAEW PPV in the UK
stories.tldr: AEW star Skye Blue is heading to the United Kingdom to challenge for the Spirit of EVE Championship against reigning titleholder Lucy Deathmatch at the upcoming Pro Wrestling EVE MyAEW PPV event. The high-stakes showdown takes place on Sunday, November 8, at The Hanger in Wolverhampton, England, and stems from a previous encounter during All In weekend. Several other prominent AEW and international names are also slated for the card, including Kris Statlander and Marina Shafir.

stories.title: PAC's wife Natalie shares tribute to late husband
stories.tldr: Natalie Satterley has shared a heartbreaking public tribute to her late husband, Benjamin Satterley, known to wrestling fans as PAC. Marking over two weeks since his sudden passing, she reflected on their 21 years together and the retirement plans they will no longer get to fulfill. Peers throughout the industry have continued to express their condolences and support for his grieving family.

stories.title: Matt Hardy praises AEW tribute to PAC
stories.tldr: Following the recent passing of PAC, AEW held an emotional tribute episode of Dynamite featuring special matches and video packages. TNA star Matt Hardy recently shared his thoughts on the broadcast during his podcast. Hardy praised the company for putting together a classy and well-done tribute that helped everyone grieve. He also reflected on an eerie Jon Moxley promo from All Out that featured PAC in hindsight.

stories.title: Max Caster seems to have picked the wrong target for an ‘edgy’ bar in his TNA debut
stories.tldr: Following his recent departure from AEW, Max Caster made a controversial TNA debut at Bound for Glory by dropping an unapproved freestyle rap. The lyrics referencing a glory hole and Riyadh drew immediate backstage heat and caused TNA to scrub the footage from their channels. Reports conflict on whether he has already been released or faces an uncertain future, but the incident has severely jeopardized his new run and complicated partner relations.

stories.title: Tommaso Ciampa and Charles Mason Kiss at Indie Show
stories.tldr: AEW star Tommaso Ciampa made a rare independent wrestling appearance at the House of Glory Salvation event on October 9, facing Charles Mason in the main event. During the match, the two sadistic competitors shocked fans by sharing a kiss as a psychological power play before trading blows. Ciampa ultimately won the match, marking his first indie victory in approximately a decade outside of major promotions like WWE and AEW.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland Discusses Feud With Hangman Page
stories.tldr: Swerve Strickland and Hangman Adam Page have shared one of the most intensely violent and hateful rivalries in All Elite Wrestling history, featuring shocking moments like Page burning down Strickland's childhood home and Strickland breaking into Page's residence. Despite the hostility now reaching the trios division, Strickland revealed in a recent interview that he hopes the program will ultimately be remembered as one of the greatest feuds in professional wrestling history. He attributes the captivating nature of their rivalry to a shared personal vulnerability and an ability to exploit each other's emotions in front of an eagerly anticipating audience.

stories.title: AEW WrestleDream 2026 Match Card and Title Changes
stories.tldr: Following recent events at Grand Slam France, several new matches and title bouts have been added to the AEW WrestleDream 2026 card, including Andrade defending the National Championship against Tommaso Ciampa and Mercedes Mone defending the Women's World Title against Thekla. Additionally, Wrathlander earned a tag team title shot, and the United Empire faction officially expanded with new members. The upcoming three-hour go-home show will also feature multiple high-profile tag team and preview matches.
